tiers.A: Primary institutional catalogue; may support identity when record rights and provenance pass
tiers.B: Licensed specialist catalogue/API; may support identity under its contract and attribution rules
tiers.C: Auction archive or specialist publication; corroboration only unless independently verified
tiers.D: Forum, marketplace, community correction; discovery lead only until curated

sources.name: Muzeum Narodowe w Krakowie — Zbiory Cyfrowe
sources.rightsGate: Accept only records explicitly marked Domena publiczna and unrestricted

sources.name: Muzeum Narodowe w Warszawie — Cyfrowe MNW
sources.rightsGate: The importer simultaneously requires keyword monety polskie (175926) and copyright DOMENA PUBLICZNA (500); it rejects non-coins, counterfeits, copies, restrikes and records without a recognized denomination

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons — historyczne monety polskie i ziem polskich
sources.rightsGate: Accept only item files carrying compatible CC/CC BY/CC BY-SA or public-domain metadata; reject counterfeits, restrikes, proofs and ambiguous matches

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons — falsyfikaty, repliki i formy odlewnicze monet
sources.rightsGate: Accept only files from explicitly negative Commons categories with item-level PD/CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA metadata; reject NC/ND and keep every record outside the positive identity catalogue

sources.name: Narodowy Bank Polski
sources.rightsGate: Follow NBP image-reuse conditions; factual metadata kept separate from image permissions

sources.name: APOMONET — otwarty katalog monet PRL 1949–1989
sources.rightsGate: CC BY-SA 4.0 revision provenance for structured facts; official ELI/ISAP references retained; Commons images accepted only after an item-level CC/PD licence check

sources.name: APOMONET — otwarty katalog polskich monet próbnych 1949–1994
sources.rightsGate: CC BY-SA 4.0 revision provenance for structured table facts; contemporary catalogue numbering, auction photographs and page prose excluded; Commons images accepted only after an item-level licence check

sources.name: APOMONET — otwarty katalog monet III RP 1995–2024
sources.rightsGate: CC BY-SA 4.0 revision provenance for structured table facts; page prose, NBP images, auction media and contemporary catalogue numbering excluded

sources.name: APOMONET — zweryfikowane fakty z dawnych aukcji i periodyków
sources.rightsGate: Własny zapis faktów wchodzi do runtime tylko po zgodności z niezależnym rekordem instytucjonalnym; tekst, układ, ceny z niepewnego OCR, skany i fotografie pozostają wyłączone

sources.name: Dawne katalogi i periodyki numizmatyczne — kontrolowany przegląd praw
sources.rightsGate: Osobna decyzja dla tekstu, układu, fotografii/tablicy, skanu i regulaminu repozytorium; sam wiek publikacji i nieistnienie domu aukcyjnego nie wystarczają

sources.name: POLONA / Biblioteka Narodowa
sources.rightsGate: Only public-domain objects; transform facts into APOMONET records with page-level provenance

sources.name: Emeric Hutten-Czapski — Catalogue de la collection des médailles et monnaies polonaises, tomy I–V
sources.rightsGate: KPBC oznacza pięć tomów jako domenę publiczną i dostęp bez ograniczeń; przechowujemy własne pola faktograficzne oraz numer tomu, pozycji i strony, bez skanów i bez kopiowania narracji katalogowej

sources.name: IKMK — sieć publicznych zbiorów numizmatycznych
sources.rightsGate: Store normalized factual fields and LOD identifiers; do not copy catalogue prose; retain an image URL only when the individual JSON-IKMK record declares PDM/CC and no restriction

sources.name: American Numismatic Society — MANTIS
sources.rightsGate: Collections metadata under ODbL 1.0; import only normalized facts and record links; media excluded

sources.name: Józef Tyszkiewicz — Podręcznik numizmatyczny (1890)
sources.rightsGate: Use the 1890 public-domain original from POLONA with page-level provenance; preserve historical values as historical catalogue assessments, never as current PLN valuation

sources.name: Edmund Kopicki — katalogi monet polskich
sources.rightsGate: No bulk transcription, scans, tables or systematic numbering import without a licence; allow isolated references only after independent variant confirmation and provenance

sources.name: Numista API
sources.rightsGate: API contract, N# and Source: Numista attribution; no bulk copy or long-lived metadata cache

sources.name: Europeana APIs
sources.rightsGate: Europeana metadata reused as normalized facts with provider and record provenance; media excluded unless separately licensed at item level

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.rightsGate: Use only records and assets carrying compatible Open Access rights

sources.name: APOMONET — zweryfikowane rekordy faktograficzne
sources.rightsGate: Store only independently structured facts, historical legends, measurements, literature identifiers and direct provenance links; never copy protected photos or descriptions

sources.name: APOMONET — indeks dawnych kolekcji i katalogów aukcyjnych
sources.rightsGate: Store only bibliographic facts, lot identifiers, section ranges and direct links. No catalogue prose, plates or photographs unless an item carries an independently checked compatible licence.

sources.name: Muzeum Narodowe w Warszawie — kolekcje Potockich i Sobańskiego
sources.rightsGate: Promote only individual public-domain coin objects that pass the MNW positive-identity filter; copies, casts and counterfeits remain outside the positive catalogue.

sources.name: Východoslovenské múzeum — skarb złoty z Koszyc
sources.rightsGate: Aggregate facts and bibliography only; no bulk catalogue transcription or photography without item-level permission.

sources.name: Auction-house archives
sources.rightsGate: No copied photos or descriptions without licence; direct links and independently structured facts only

sources.name: Numismatic forums and user corrections
sources.rightsGate: Consent, provenance and independent verification required before promotion
